scoring_justification: Recompute adhesion energy from constituent total energies in the CSV and compare to paper-reported gold values with tolerance; full T1 recompute is feasible.

outputs.description: Eight rows, one per condition. Columns: system (string: 'graphitic_slit' or 'cnt_9_9'), molecule (string: benzene, chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene, isopropylbenzene), E_combined (float, eV), E_system (float, eV), E_molecule (float, eV), E_adhesion (float, eV).

output_contract.notes: The task requires plane-wave DFT calculations which are computationally intensive. The solving agent is expected to install an open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) and retrieve appropriate pseudopotentials at runtime. Only the final scored CSV artifact is required to be placed under /app/outputs; intermediate DFT output files are not required.

steps.notes: For each condition, recompute adhesion = E_combined - E_system - E_molecule and compare to gold. Tolerance = max(0.02 eV, 0.20 * |gold|).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold adhesion energies for the 8 conditions (4 molecules x 2 substrates)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: Graphitic slit adhesion energy (eV/molecule) and (9,9) Carbon nanotube adhesion energy (eV/molecule).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the published paper table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper that the task aims to reproduce.
